# pool

The subnet's AMM pool at the current block: price, reserves and what a trade of a given size would do.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`pool.price()`](#pool-price) | Pool price, TAO per alpha: the current block's in precise and live runs; the bar's close inside `event.onCandle` in quick backtests. |
| [`pool.movingPrice()`](#pool-movingprice) | The protocol's moving (smoothed) price at the current block or bar. |
| [`pool.reserves()`](#pool-reserves) | Pool reserves at the current block or bar. |
| [`pool.impact()`](#pool-impact) | fraction of price impact for buying `tao` TAO at current reserves |
| [`pool.quoteBuy()`](#pool-quotebuy) | What buying with `tao` TAO (fee included) would return at the current reserves. |
| [`pool.quoteSell()`](#pool-quotesell) | What selling `alpha` would return at the current reserves, after the fee. |
| [`pool.capacity()`](#pool-capacity) | largest TAO size whose impact stays within `maxImpact` (fraction) |

## Types

### Reserves {#reserves}

Pool reserves.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `taoIn` | `number` | TAO in the pool |
| `alphaIn` | `number` | alpha in the pool |
| `alphaOut` | `number` | alpha outstanding (staked outside the pool) |

### Quote {#quote}

What a trade would do at the current reserves (`pool.quoteBuy()` / `pool.quoteSell()`).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha?` | `number` | amount received: `alpha` for a buy, `tao` (after the fee) for a sell |
| `tao?` | `number` |  |
| `price` | [`Price`](./types#price) | average price of the trade, fee excluded |
| `impact` | `number` | fraction, e.g. 0.005 = 0.5 % |
| `fee` | `number` | fee in TAO |
